name: Ratangad Fort
tagline: Steel ladders, ridge walking, and the 'Nedhe' needle-eye rock formation
seoTitle: Ratangad Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Ratangad Fort near Bhandardara — steel ladders, the Nedhe rock formation, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — best views of Bhandardara Lake and the Kalsubai range, but scree is riskier wet

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Drier scree section, safer footing on the Nedhe approach

routeOptions.name: From Ratanwadi
routeOptions.notes: Involves steel ladders and rock-cut steps; the final approach to the Nedhe (needle-eye rock) is steep and scree-covered.

safety.intro: Ratangad's ladders and ridge sections are exposed — this isn't a trek to attempt in poor weather or with a fear of heights.

alerts.title: Scree-covered final approach to the Nedhe
alerts.body: The loose rock near the needle-eye formation is genuinely unstable underfoot — worse when wet. Test each foothold and avoid this stretch in heavy rain.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Confirm the steel ladders are in good condition via recent trekker reports — maintenance varies
Start early — this is a full day out from Ratanwadi

cards.title: On the trail
items: Use both hands on the ladder sections, don't rush
The ridge walking near the top is exposed — go slow in wind

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: The ladder sections are safer with at least one other person nearby to assist if needed
Tell your Ratanwadi homestay/contact your route and expected return

items.name: Sturdy trekking shoes with ankle support
Gloves for the steel ladder sections
3L water — limited sources on the ascent
Trekking pole for the scree section
